OCR models used by Local Media Viewer's text recognition (glyph-ocr)
=====================================================================

The three ONNX files in this folder are derived from official PaddleOCR models
and were converted to ONNX by the RapidOCR project. They are redistributed here
unchanged, exactly as obtained from:

  https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR  (release v3.7.0, onnx/PP-OCRv4/)

  ch_PP-OCRv4_det_infer.onnx            text detection
    SHA-256 d2a7720d45a54257208b1e13e36a8479894cb74155a5efe29462512d42f49da9
  ch_ppocr_mobile_v2.0_cls_infer.onnx   text direction classification
    SHA-256 e47acedf663230f8863ff1ab0e64dd2d82b838fceb5957146dab185a89d6215c
  japan_PP-OCRv4_rec_infer.onnx         Japanese text recognition
    SHA-256 e1075a67dba758ecfc7ebc78a10ae61c95ac8fb66a9c86fab5541e33f085cb7a
